text_block_list.text:
I'm wandering the school grounds when I
bump
into Бива Хаяхидэ, who looks
quite ill.

Haha... Not exactly. I have a slight
headache.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I checked the weather reports thinking a
change
in barometric pressure triggered
it, but there
haven't been any major
fluctuations recently.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm experiencing fatigue and intermittent
pain as
well, so it's likely a migraine, but
I can't rule out
other pathologies.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I compared my symptoms against other
illnesses
to be cautious, but the more I
think about it, the
more my head hurts...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: You're overthinking again. Take a deep breath.

text_block_list.text:
You're right... I recall reading a study
that
mentioned the importance of
resting your nerves.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Ngh... I just can't seem to settle
down.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ's seems to really be
overthinking
her headache...
